question: The Gol Gumbaz the tomb of Mohammed Adil Shah is in ______.
solution: The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Gol Gumbaz** is located in **Bijapur**, a city in the state of **Karnataka, India**. • It is the **mausoleum** of **Mohammed Adil Shah**, the Sultan of Bijapur, who ruled between **1627 and 1656**. • The structure is renowned for its **exceptional architectural design**, particularly its massive dome, which is one of the **largest unsupported domes in the world**. • Gol Gumbaz is built using **Deccan Indo-Islamic architecture**, showcasing the influence of Persian and Indian styles. • The tomb is famous for its **whispering gallery**, where even the faintest sound can be heard clearly across the gallery due to its unique acoustic design.
